title: plugins.lock v0
description: The plugin set of a desk, ~/.desk/plugins.lock (ADR 0079): one line per installed plugin, rewritten by the core on every install, removal, version change and turn on or off. `desk plugin list --lock` prints it and `desk plugin sync` turns plugins on and off as it says. The file is YAML; this schema describes the data it holds once parsed.

version.description: The format version. Desk refuses a lock newer than it reads.

plugins.description: Every installed plugin that validates, sorted by id.

sha256.description: The folder digest: every regular file under the plugin folder whose path has no part starting with a dot, in byte order of its path relative to the folder (forward slashes), each fed as path, NUL, decimal length, NUL, bytes; lowercase hex.

enabled.description: Whether it is on, as its persisted flag says (init.yaml's start-only holds aside).

LockSource.description: Where the plugin came from: builtin (shipped with Desk), folder:<path> (a folder on this computer, ~ for the home folder) or url:<https URL> (the market, later).
